name: Cork
housing: Cork's rentals are a mix of terraced and semi-detached houses, many shared by students near UCC and MTU, and city-centre apartments.

localRules.text: Landlords in Ireland must register each tenancy with the Residential Tenancies Board within one month of it starting, and every year after.

tenantHelp.name: Residential Tenancies Board (RTB)
tenantHelp.what: state body for tenancy registration and deposit disputes

climate: Cork is wet, so check walls and windows for damp and mould and test the heating.
fact: Bishopstown and Wilton near the universities have many shared student houses.
